release_title: DeepSeek V3.2 正式版：强化 Agent 能力，融入思考推理（V3.2 + V3.2-Speciale）

models.name: DeepSeek-V3.2
models.variant: GA model: thinking integrated with tool calling (first DeepSeek model to do so); balance of reasoning and output length
models.capability_summary: DeepSeek 官方将 V3.2 正式版定位为「强化 Agent 能力、融入思考推理」，是 DeepSeek 首个将思考与工具调用融合的模型。已收录 26 项评测覆盖数学竞赛、代码、知识与工具/Agent 使用：亮点 AIME 2025（Thinking）93.1、Codeforces（Thinking）2386。

models.name: DeepSeek-V3.2-Speciale
models.variant: long-thinking enhancement + DeepSeek-Math-V2 theorem proving; research-only temporary API, no tool calling
models.capability_summary: DeepSeek-V3.2-Speciale 定位为长思考增强叠加 DeepSeek-Math-V2 定理证明的研究用临时 API（无工具调用）。已收录 Speciale 行集中于数学与竞赛推理：亮点 HMMT 2025 年 2 月卷 99.2、Codeforces 2701，另在 IMO/CMO/ICPC/IOI 2025 取得金牌级结论。

protocol.judge: Doubao-Seed-1.6-1015（论文初始版数据 2,998 条细则的判分模型；仓库 v1.1 改用 Doubao-Seed-2.0-lite 判分，同一判分提示词）

benchmark_evidence.notes: AppCIF-Bench 官方仓库 Leaderboard 表中「DeepSeek-V3.2-Thinking」行的 SSR L1 列（SSR 软满足率 = 被满足的细则占全部细则的比例；本列分母为 727 条细则）。本列为该难度档的分档数值。口径警示：榜单是中文版数据、论文初始版 2,998 条细则、由 Doubao-Seed-1.6-1015 判分；仓库现发布 v1.1（466 样本 / 3,017 条细则）并改用 Doubao-Seed-2.0-lite 判分，官方明示两套分数不可直接比较，故本行数值不代表该模型在 v1.1 上的表现。同列竞品（取本表其他行数值）：GPT-5.4-xhigh 79.1 / Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview 82.4 / Doubao-Seed-2.0-Pro-high 66.6 / GLM-5.1 65.2 / Gemini-3-Flash-Preview 66.4 / Kimi-K2.5-Thinking 60.4 / Qwen-3.6-Plus-Thinking 57.4 / Grok-4.2 55.3 / Xiaomi-MiMo-V2-Pro 42.0 / Minimax-M2.7 35.5 / Xiaomi-MiMo-V2-Omni 39.1。该列最佳：Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview 82.4。榜单由基准所有者（腾讯）自建自跑并自报，非第三方独立评测，横向比较仅限同一判分模型与同一数据版本内。AppCIF 榜单标签「DeepSeek-V3.2-Thinking」对应账本 release deepseek-v3-2 / model deepseek-v3-2。官方原始页面归档 models/2026-11-05-appcif-bench/；数据集与评测代码 https://github.com/Tencent-Hunyuan/AppCIF-Bench ；项目页 https://ac2333.github.io/AppCIF/ 。

notes: Release date: official news sidebar 'DeepSeek-V3.2 正式版发布 2025/12/01', slug news251201, and HuggingFace deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3.2 createdAt 2025-12-01T02:34:49Z all agree. GA of the V3.2 line two months after V3.2-Exp (user feedback found no scenario where Exp was significantly worse than V3.1-Terminus, validating DSA). All numeric benchmark scores render inside three webp images (benchmark.webp hero, benchmark_table_cn.webp = Table 1 with per-cell token consumption, agent_benchmark.webp = Table 2); all printed cells were re-read from the archived images on 2026-09-01 and are enumerated as evidence rows, including the full V3.2-Speciale column of Table 1 and the hero-chart-only SWE Verified / Terminal-Bench 2.0 values. Cross-vendor consistency: the V3.2-Thinking values read from Table 1 (HLE 25.1, GPQA-D 82.4, HMMT Nov 90.2, IMOAnswerBench 78.3, LiveCodeBench 83.3) match the DeepSeek-V3.2 competitor columns printed in GLM-4.7/GLM-5/GLM-5.1 and Kimi K2.5 pages - four independent renderings agree. Agent training data synthesis disclosed: 1800+ environments, 85,000+ complex instructions, no tool-specific training for the agent benchmarks (generalization claim).
